title: Shiba Inu Rooms Manga Gets TV Anime in Summer 2027
content: Wright Film announced on Sunday that Esu Omori 's Shiba Inu Rooms ( Shiba-tsuki Bukken ) manga is getting a television anime series that will debut in summer 2027. The staff said the anime was announced on Sunday as November 1 was "Wan Wan Wan Day" ("Wan" being the sound of a dog barking in Japanese).
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Reveals 12 New Culling Game Character Posters Ahead of Season 4
content: JUJUTSU KAISEN revealed 12 new character poster visuals for Culling Game Arc Part 1 (Season 3) ahead of Season 4. It was previously announced that Takeru Sato, who served as the assistant director in Season 3, will also direct the new season. Shota Goshozono’s role is listed as chief director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dragon Ball Creator Akira Toriyama’s Home Is Being Torn Down According to Eye-Witness Reports
content: According to new eye-witness reports from those in the area, the former home and studio of the late Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama is currently being demolished, and those involved with the franchise over the years have shared their confusion about it all with fans on social media.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Highlights Culling Game Roster With New Posters Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is gearing up for a return to the Culling Game with a fun recap of the roster of fighters from its first half with some cool new posters ahead of the anime’s next new season.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia, Frieren & More Anime Return for Spooky New Halloween Makeovers
content: My Hero Academia , Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End, Oshi no Ko and more have gone all out for Halloween with some spooky makeovers for the holiday. The Halloween holiday is a pretty big deal in the anime world as it allows the production team for each franchise to play around a bit with the characters and their designs.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach’s Spinoff Would Be a Perfect New Anime After Finale Tease
content: The Bleach anime has finally come to an end with the adaptation of the Thousand-Year Blood War , more than a decade after its manga first concluded. However, there are still many ways the series could be expanded, as the finale laid down several hints about the franchise’s future.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Confirms U.S. Release Date for Major Anime Movie Finale – Watch New Trailer
content: A major anime franchise is coming to an end eight years after its original debut with a new feature film finale , and Crunchyroll has now confirmed its release date for fans in the United States with a new trailer and poster showing it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer Drops Cute New Look at the Coolest Hashira Ahead of Infinity Castle Part 2
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba fans are still waiting on the next Infinity Castle movie , but the franchise has dropped a cute new look at the Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, to help celebrate his birthday in the meantime.
author: ComicBook

title: Seth MacFarlane & American Dad Honor Patrick Stewart With Tribute: “Deeply Missed By the Entire Planet”
content: Legendary star of stage and screen Patrick Stewart has sadly passed away at the age of 86 this week , and American Dad! and franchise creator Seth MacFarlane have shared emotional tributes to the star thanks to all of the work he’s done across MacFarlane’s works like American Dad!, Family Guy, Ted and more.
author: ComicBook

title: DC Studios’ New Green Lantern Animated Series Confirms Episode Count With Promising Update
content: Warner Bros. Animation and DC Studios are now in the works on a new animated series set in the same universe as My Adventures with Superman , and Peter Safran has shared a promising update on how it’s all coming along with a confirmation of how long it’s debut outing is going to be.
author: ComicBook
